description: This Python source file defines a class `PDFProcessor` responsible for processing PDF documents. It extracts text and images from PDFs, chunks text into segments suitable for further processing, and saves extracted images to a specified directory. The class uses external libraries like fitz (PyMuPDF) for PDF handling and PIL for image processing.
